Name: Lance but with chin hair - SVE
Author: migskiee
Description:
I always thought Lance was giving goatee vibes so here's a horrible attempt at that. Edited his portrait after meeting the guy, this was just for personal use then I decided to share in case anyone's interested.

also includes his seasonal [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]portraits[/url].

The mod now has an Overlay version provided by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/0krisa/mods]0krisa[/url]. Be sure to check their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23691]Full beard for Philip[/url] which adds more facial hair to Philip from Ridgeside Village!

Downloads.Description: replaces Lance's portraits to give him a little goatie.
An overlay version provided by 0krisa, you shouldn't have to keep reinstalling the mod anymore after updating SVE.
